simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רָטַשׁ (H7376) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

simple.summary: רָטַשׁ (râṭâsh) means to dash down First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 8 12.

definitions.full: H7376. ratash [ רָטַשׁ ] verb Pi`el dash in pieces (compare רְטַשׁ ᵑ7 cast away, reject; but possibly akin to לָטַשׁ ); — Pi`el Imperfect 2masculine singular תְּרַטֵּשׁ 2Kin 8:12 their children thou will dash in pieces ; 3 feminine plural תְּרַטַּשְׁנָה נְעָרִים קְשָׁתוֺת Isa 13:18 , but probably corrupt, Du conjecture תְּרֻטַּשְׁנָה נְעָרוֺת compare Che. Pu`al Perfect 3feminine singular רֻטָּ֑שָׁה בָּנִים עַלֿ אֵם Hosea 14:14; Imperfect 3masculine plural יְרֻטְּשׁוּ Isa 13:16 ; Nahum 3:10 , יְרֻטָּ֑שׁוּ Hosea 14:1 , all of children. רִי see רוה .
